description: This file defines the 'ChangeSetExecutorCallback' interface used for callback functionality during database updates in the OpenMRS project, specifically related to Liquibase change sets execution.

classes.name: ChangeSetExecutorCallback
classes.description: An interface for defining callback actions to be performed after each Liquibase changeset execution during database updates.

methods.name: executing
methods.description: Method invoked after each changeset is executed, receiving the changeset and total number of changesets as parameters.
